# fjordrun_personal_tokens (Data Source)

Your personal access tokens' metadata. Needs a personal access token. They are created by `fjordrun login`, so there is no resource for them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fjordrun_personal_tokens" "mine" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `tokens` (Attributes List) The tokens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tokens`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `current` (Boolean) Whether the provider is using this one.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry.
- `id` (String) Token ID.
- `last_used_at` (String) Last use.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `prefix` (String) Visible prefix.
